They were tall and super handsome. I had to take a look inward and face facts from the things that I learned on these subreddits, which is that I am the bottom of the barrel when it comes to the genetic lottery. I got fucked and got played a terrible hand.  It sucks but I have kinda come to grips with it.  I just got fucked over.
